exposure: History of retained placenta (partial or complete)
cohort: The study included 2177 parturients who experienced at least one episode of retained placenta in an index delivery and had subsequent deliveries at Shaare Zedek Medical Center between 2005 and 2018.
finding: A history of retained placenta, particularly the complete type, significantly increases the risk of recurrence in subsequent deliveries, with induction of labor and epidural analgesia also identified as independent risk factors.
